THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Sri. Ravi B.Patil., learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri. Shivakumar R. Tengli., learned AGA for respondents 4 to 6 have appeared in person.

The captioned Writ Petition is filed seeking a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents 4 to 6 to consider the representations of the petitioners submitted on 02.11.2022 and 11.01.2023 as per Annexures-F & F1 and to bifurcate the lands by drawing the phodi sketch identifying the extent of the portion of the land to be utilized under the project by paying compensation.

2. The brief facts are these:
Petitioners 1 to 4 purchased respective portions of land and they are the owners of the respective portions of land in Sy.No.262 total measuring 10 Acres 25 Guntas situated at Khadar Nagar village, Bidar Taluk and District.
The fifth respondent issued 3(A) Notification under the National Highway Act for acquiring the portion of the land in Sy.No.262 for the construction/building of the National Highway.

It is said that the petitioners were constrained to make necessary representations to the office of the Tahasildar and the ADLR Bidar seeking division of the respective extent of their land to facilitate the payment of compensation; petitioners also sought for bifurcation of the lands.
It is averred that the authority concerned acquired the lands in the year 2019 and they utilized the land to an extent of 05 Acres 22 Guntas out of 10 Acres 25 Guntas.
The competent authority passed the award on 24.07.2019.

sentences.text: As things stood thus, the petitioners made a request to the authorities concerned to bifurcate the land that has been utilized for the formation of the National Highway.

Pursuant to the request made by the petitioners, the ADLR, Bidar District, conducted a survey, drew mahazar & also sketch, and identified the extent of the land that is utilized for the formation of the National Highway.

The grievance of the petitioners is that the remaining land has to be bifurcated by drawing a phodi sketch identifying the extent of left out portion of the land of each of the petitioners and the same has to be handed over to the petitioners and form No.10 has to be issued to the petitioners.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners and the respondents have urged several contentions.
4.
Heard the contentions urged on behalf of the respective parties and perused the Writ papers and also the Annexures with utmost care.

Counsel Sri. Ravi B.Patil., in presenting his arguments submitted that despite the effort made by the ADLR, the authorities concerned have not taken any steps to consider the grievance of the petitioners to bifurcate the land.
Counsel, therefore, submits that appropriate direction may be issued to respondents 4 to 6 to consider the grievance of the petitioners and to act in accordance with the law.

In reply, Sri. Shivakumar R. Tengli, learned AGA submits that if reasonable time is granted to the authorities concerned to meet the grievance of the petitioners i.e., bifurcation of the land by drawing podi sketch, identifying the remaining extent of land belonging to the petitioners and issuing Form No.10 to the petitioners
, the authorities concerned would consider the same in accordance with the law.
The submission made on behalf of the learned AGA is placed on record.
In view of the submission made on behalf of the State, this Court deems it proper to direct respondents 4 to 6 to consider the request of the petitioners as per Annexures F & F1.

A Writ of Mandamus is issued and respondents 4 to 6 are directed to consider the request of the petitioners as per Annexures-F & F1 within three months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
Resultantly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.

Sd/-
